scenes.title: Covering and fencing
scenes.learnerAction: Use the model, complete its task, and explain what the representation shows.

content.body: Synthetic school-garden demonstration. Count square metres inside the rectangle and trace metres around its boundary. A triangle with base 6 m and perpendicular height 4 m fills half a 6-by-4 rectangle. Its sloping sides are 5 m each.

accessibility.textAlternative: Synthetic school-garden demonstration. Count square metres inside the rectangle and trace metres around its boundary. A triangle with base 6 m and perpendicular height 4 m fills half a 6-by-4 rectangle. Its sloping sides are 5 m each. A rectangle 8 m long and 5 m wide. Area 40 square m; perimeter 26 m. Area covers the inside; perimeter follows the edge. A triangle with a base of 6 m and a perpendicular height of 4 m, measured at a right angle to the base. Its other two sides are 5 m and 5 m. Use perpendicular height, not a sloping side.

scenes.title: Explain both measurements
scenes.learnerAction: Use the model, complete its task, and explain what the representation shows.

content.body: Watch the method before trying a new garden. Multiplication counts square units. Addition measures the boundary. The same number can never stand for both measurements without stating its unit.

accessibility.textAlternative: Watch the method before trying a new garden. Multiplication counts square units. Addition measures the boundary. The same number can never stand for both measurements without stating its unit. An 8 m by 5 m garden needs mulch and fencing. A rectangle 8 m long and 5 m wide. Area 40 square m; perimeter 26 m. Step 1: Count 5 rows of 8 unit squares. A = 8 × 5 = 40 m² Step 2: Add all four sides. P = 2(8 + 5) = 26 m Find both measurements of the triangular bed. A triangle with a base of 6 m and a perpendicular height of 4 m, measured at a right angle to the base. Its other two sides are 5 m and 5 m. Step 1: Halve the base-by-height rectangle. A = 1/2 × 6 × 4 = 12 m² Step 2: Add the three boundary lengths, not the height. P = 6 + 5 + 5 = 16 m
